findings.description: The static scanner flagged 'SECRET = "glide.openaiApiKey"' as a hardcoded secret. However, this string is a configuration key name (namespace.property) used to look up the user's API key in VS Code settings, not the secret value itself.

The scanner flagged 'workspace.getConfiguration(CONFIG_SECTION).update(' as programmatic tampering. In the context of an extension that manages its own settings (like an API key), updating its own configuration section is standard behavior to persist user input.

The extension activates on 'onStartupFinished'. While this is common for AI completion extensions to ensure they are ready when the user starts typing, it is slightly broader than necessary for a simple command-triggered tool. However, given the 'low-latency' goal, this is acceptable.
